title: Splash / first load
one_line: Logo, mascot, a progress bar that tells the truth about what is actually loading.

anatomy.spec: bg_menu_emboss or a dedicated splash ground - decide with the owner; default to the same menu wallpaper for consistency.
LUDO NX logotype, centred, upper half.
One pose, waving or idle. At most one per screen.
Progress bar (bible 5.12), recessed track, amber gradient fill, tied to REAL loading progress (asset load, auth check, config fetch) - not a fake timed bar.

states: Slow network - after ~6s show a short honest line, e.g. 'Still loading...'
Load failed - a RETRY button, never an infinite spinner
motion: Progress fill animates smoothly, no jumps.
Logo settles with a soft scale-in on first frame.
data: Real asset/auth/config load progress drives the bar.
do_not: Do not fake the progress bar with a timer - tie it to real load steps.
Do not let a failed load spin forever with no retry.
acceptance: Progress bar reflects real load steps.
steps: 2. Wire the progress bar to real load milestones.
3. Add the slow-network line and the failure/RETRY state.
4. Capture normal, slow and failed. Postflight.
prompt:
Polish the Ludo NX splash screen.

Read SCREEN_PLANS/specs/SHARED_RULES.md, UI_BIBLE/LUDO_NX_UI_BIBLE.md sections 4.4 and 5.12, and this whole file. Use only values from UI_BIBLE/tokens.json.

The one rule that matters here: the progress bar must reflect REAL loading progress (assets, auth, config) - never a fake timed animation. Add an honest 'Still loading...' line if it runs past about 6 seconds, and a RETRY button if loading fails outright, instead of spinning forever.

Follow the 'steps' array. Finish with bible section 11 and the 'acceptance' list.
